checks_run.procedure: Adversarial verification of F-DG2-180. Source review of the one shared predicate (common.ts:51) and its users (hasText, freeText, trimmedText name/reason, web). Schema-level Unicode matrix through freeText(1,100), hasText, name and reason, covering the round-3 and round-4 sets plus Cc, lone surrogates, tags and unassigned DI. Visible-with-marks controls must be stored verbatim. Exhaustive sweeps of every Default_Ignorable, White_Space, Cc, Cf and Cs code point, a census of what is still counted visible, and timing up to 10^7 code units. End to end: re-run the unchanged round-4 repro, then the round-5 probe D1-D4 through the API (Out of scope, archive reason, transformation name), twice on fresh disposable clusters.
checks_run.command: node probes/schema-unicode-matrix-r5.mts $TMPDIR/review-probe/packages/shared; with-pg.sh 55621|55624 pnpm vitest run --project integration zz-sec-r3-invisible zz-sec-r4-probe zz-sec-r4-oidc zz-sec-r5-probe zz-sec-r5-oidc [zz-sec-r5-readyz zz-sec-r5-nul] --reporter=verbose
checks_run.environment: disposable clone $TMPDIR/review-probe @96a3c293 with probe files copied in (untracked); Node v22.22.2 (matrix v24.21.0); PostgreSQL 16.13 (nested user ns, 127.0.0.1)
checks_run.expected: every reported code point and every Default_Ignorable/Cc/Cf/Cs/White_Space code point is not content (400 validation.blank, hasText false, nothing stored); visible text with marks is accepted and stored verbatim; linear time
checks_run.actual: Matrix: 0 unexpected results. The exhaustive sweeps find 0 of 4174 DI, 0 of 25 White_Space, 0 of 65 Cc, 0 of 170 Cf and 0 of 2048 Cs still counted visible. 10^7 code units take 103-139 ms. The round-4 repro zz-sec-r4-probe.test.ts passes 8/8 in both runs, including all of part C (U+FE0F, U+034F x2, U+180B, U+17B4, RLM+VS16 -> 400; archive reason U+FE0F x3 -> 400). zz-sec-r5-probe passes D1-D4 in both runs. D1-D3: 13 invisible values -> 400 validation.blank at /outOfScope, /reason and /name; GET charter 404, no audit row for the request, gap still open v1, transformation count unchanged. D4: 7 visible-with-marks Out of scope values -> 201, verbatim, pre-check pass; a reason and a name with marks are stored verbatim. F-DG2-180 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. Probing outside the reported set found two placeholder code points that no property covers (U+16FE4, U+1D159; part E fails by design in both runs), raised as new Low F-DG2-230.

checks_run.procedure: UTF8 database requirement (BE9 786f574, D-065). Source review of packages/db/src/encoding.ts, migrate.ts (assert before pg_advisory_lock and CREATE TABLE), cli.ts (assertUtf8Database(pool) before status/bootstrap/seed-dev; migrate goes through migrate()) and global-setup. Candidate test encoding.test.ts in both integration runs. Adversarial probe: migrate() through a URL whose options add -c client_encoding=LATIN1 on a SQL_ASCII database.
checks_run.command: git diff e37f6ea4..96a3c293 -- packages/db; with-pg.sh 55623|55624 pnpm vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r5-readyz.test.ts
checks_run.expected: any non-UTF8 database is refused before any lock, table or migration; the check cannot be fooled by client settings
checks_run.actual: encoding.ts reads SHOW server_encoding, a read-only GUC fixed at CREATE DATABASE. migrate() asserts before the advisory lock; the CLI asserts before every other command; DatabaseEncodingError maps to 'mth-db: ...' and exit 1. encoding.test.ts passes 8/8 in both runs: migrate/status/seed-dev/bootstrap exit 1 with the exact message; no schema_migration table and 0 user objects; migrate() throws; the control migrates UTF8. Probe: with -c client_encoding=LATIN1 in the URL options, migrate() is still refused(SQL_ASCII) with 0 objects created (both runs).

checks_run.procedure: /readyz (apps/api/src/modules/platform/health.ts). Source review. Adversarial probe zz-sec-r5-readyz.test.ts. (1) Positive-cache masking: start the API on a migrated UTF8 database (200, encoding cached), then DROP it and recreate it under the SAME name as SQL_ASCII while the process runs; probe 4 times, attempt migrate(), probe again; then a fresh process. (2) Not-ready path writes nothing: 5 probes on a SQL_ASCII database, counting pg_class objects. (3) The body leaks no internals. Candidate tests health.test.ts (unit) and platform.test.ts (integration).
checks_run.command: with-pg.sh 55623 pnpm vitest run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/zz-sec-r5-readyz.test.ts --reporter=verbose (also in probe run 2 on 55624)
checks_run.expected: the cache can never produce a false 200; the not-ready path is read-only; the body holds only status/checks
checks_run.actual: 3/3 PASS in both runs. The swap gave 4 x 503 {database: ok, migrations: pending}; migrate() was refused with the UTF8 message; the next probe was still 503; a fresh process returned 503 {database: fail, migrations: fail}. The false-ready path is closed because the product's tooling cannot migrate a non-UTF8 database. The SQL_ASCII database had 0 objects before and after 5 probes. The body is exactly {status, checks{database, migrations}} with no encoding, SQL_ASCII or database names; the encoding goes only to the server log (request.log.error). Candidate tests: health.test.ts (part of unit 640/640) and the platform.test.ts readiness test pass in both integration runs. Note: each unauthenticated probe of a mis-encoded database writes one error log line, the same pattern as the existing warn on a DB failure; not a finding.

summary: PASS. F-DG2-180 and F-DG2-181 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. The shared predicate now excludes White_Space, Cc, Cf, Cs and Default_Ignorable: the exhaustive sweeps find 0 residuals, the round-4 repros pass, invisible values are refused with 400 at /outOfScope, /reason and /name, and visible text with marks (VS16 emoji, RLM + Arabic, combining marks) is stored verbatim. The OIDC display name is truncated by code point and then checked, with (iss, sub) binding, sessions and authz unchanged. The UTF8 guard refuses non-UTF8 databases before any lock or table. The /readyz cache cannot give a false ready, the not-ready path writes nothing and leaks nothing, and the deploy changes add no secret or privilege. All required checks pass: build, typecheck, lint, openapi 161, no-cdn and format; unit 640/640 on Node 22 and 24, also under load; integration 483/483 twice (LANG unset on a SQL_ASCII-default cluster, and LANG=C.UTF-8) with 19 migrations, contract, blank-text, oidc, encoding and the AUD-403 sweep; historical DG0/DG1. Two new Low, non-mandatory findings: F-DG2-230 (U+16FE4/U+1D159 placeholders still count as content) and F-DG2-231 (NUL inside text gives an undeclared 500; pre-existing).
